pages.title: What this unit is about
pages.body:
> 📝 **Strand 2 — Productivity Software**
Sub-strand 1: Introduction to Word Processing

Modern documents combine words with pictures, diagrams, charts, links and even videos. In this unit you will turn a plain Word document into a rich multimedia document.

pages.title: Content standard and lessons
pages.body:
> 🎯 **Content standard**
- **B9.2.1.1** Demonstrate how to use Microsoft Word (Multimedia).

> 🧭 **What you will be able to do**
- **B9.2.1.1.1** Demonstrate how to add pictures, insert a screenshot, screen clipping and print screen.
- **B9.2.1.1.2** Demonstrate the use of SmartArt.
- **B9.2.1.1.3** Demonstrate how to add multimedia (audio, video, animations), charts and hyperlinks.

> 🗺️ **Lessons in this unit**
- 4.1 Pictures, Screenshots, Screen Clipping and Print Screen
- 4.2 SmartArt in Word
- 4.3 Multimedia, Charts and Hyperlinks

**Core competencies developed:** Creativity and Innovation (CI5.4), Digital Literacy (DL5.1).

lessons.title: Pictures, Screenshots, Screen Clipping and Print Screen

pages.title: Pictures, Screenshots, Screen Clipping and Print Screen
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B9.2.1.1.1
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- use the Insert ribbon to add pictures, clip art, screenshots and screen clippings;
- use the Print Screen key to capture and insert pictures.
| **Command** | **How** |
|---|---|
| Picture from device | **Insert › Pictures › This Device** |
| Stock images / icons (modern “clip art”) | **Insert › Pictures › Stock Images** or **Insert › Icons** |
| Online pictures | **Insert › Pictures › Online Pictures** (check the licence) |
| Screenshot of a window | **Insert › Screenshot** and click a window thumbnail |
| Screen clipping | **Insert › Screenshot › Screen Clipping**, then drag over the part of the screen you need |
| **Keyboard capture** | **What it does** |
|---|---|
| PrtScn (Print Screen) | Copies the whole screen to the clipboard; paste with Ctrl + V. (In recent Windows 11 versions, PrtScn opens the **Snipping Tool** by default.) |
| Alt + PrtScn | Copies only the active window |
| Windows + PrtScn | Saves a full-screen image in **Pictures › Screenshots** |
| Windows + Shift + S | Opens the Snipping Tool to capture a rectangle, free-form shape, window or full screen |
> 💻 **Practical session**
Write a one-page “How to change your mouse pointer” guide. Capture each step with **Windows + Shift + S** and paste the images into Word. Add one stock icon and one online picture, and use **Picture Format** to crop and add borders.

pages.title: SmartArt in Word
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B9.2.1.1.2
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- use SmartArt in the Illustrations group of the Insert ribbon.
> 🪜 **Step by step — Inserting SmartArt**
1. Click **Insert › Illustrations › SmartArt**.
2. Choose a category: **List**, **Process**, **Cycle**, **Hierarchy**, **Relationship**, **Matrix**, **Pyramid** or **Picture**; click a layout, then **OK**.
3. Type the text in the **Text Pane** (press Enter for a new shape, Tab to demote).
4. Use **SmartArt Design** to change colours, apply a style or add shapes; use **Format** to change individual shapes.
> ✏️ **Worked example — Ideas**
A **Process** SmartArt for the steps of making a cup of tea; a **Hierarchy** for your school’s prefect structure; a **Cycle** for the water cycle or the 5R e-waste cycle.

lessons.title: Multimedia, Charts and Hyperlinks

pages.title: Multimedia, Charts and Hyperlinks
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B9.2.1.1.3
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- add audio, video and animations;
- insert and edit charts;
- insert hyperlinks.
| **Multimedia** | **How in Word** |
|---|---|
| Online video | **Insert › Media › Online Video**, paste a YouTube or Vimeo link. The video plays inside the document (Internet needed). |
| Audio or video file | **Insert › Text › Object › Create from File**, browse to the .mp3/.mp4 file, tick **Display as icon**. Double-clicking the icon plays it. |
| Animations | Insert an **animated GIF** with Insert › Pictures; it moves when the document is viewed in Word (for slide animations use PowerPoint). |
> 🪜 **Step by step — Inserting a chart**
1. Click **Insert › Illustrations › Chart**.
2. Choose a chart type (**Column**, **Line**, **Pie**, **Bar**) and click **OK**.
3. A small Excel window opens: type your data (e.g. the number of learners in each class), then close it.
4. Use **Chart Design** to change the style and colours, and **+ (Chart Elements)** to add titles, labels and a legend.
Hyperlinks are inserted with **Insert › Link** (**Ctrl + K**), as in Basic 8. You can link text, pictures, SmartArt shapes and chart titles.
> 💻 **Practical session — Multimedia report**
Produce a two-page report on **“Water Bodies in Ghana”** containing: a picture, a screen clipping of a map, a SmartArt diagram, a chart of data, an online video link, and hyperlinks to two credible websites.
